title: The section-valued functor is left adjoint to etale restriction
statement:
Let X be a scheme, A a functor from etale set sheaves to pro-etale set sheaves, and e_F,Y natural section equivalences A(F)(Y) ≃ Gamma(Y_et,Y.hom^*F), with the prescribed restriction law and naturality in coefficient maps. Then A is left adjoint to restriction along the inclusion X_et→X_proet. Its unit, evaluated at any etale U and decoded by e, sends s in F(U) to the inverse-image unit section restricted along U→U times_X U. This is the adjunction step for an already constructed sheaf functor, not the construction of that functor or the comparison isomorphism.
Conventions: small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]; sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]; inverse images, their units and composition isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]; terminal section transport [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-transport]; the comparison restriction functor [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

source.place: Tag 0GLZ, adjunction construction and final paragraph (original Steps 4–6)

proof.text: Construct the diagonal unit explicitly: at etale U send s to e_F,U inverse of the etale inverse-image unit restricted along U to U times_X U. Diagonal-section naturality and hres prove naturality in site arrows; hfun and naturality of the inverse-image unit prove naturality in F.

For F and G use the unique-extension theorem to turn beta maps to the restriction map eta_F followed by restriction(beta) into an equivalence. Prove its naturality in G by functoriality and in F by the constructed unit naturality. Assemble CoreHomEquiv and apply Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv.

The assembled adjunction unit is eta_F followed by the restriction of the identity, hence eta_F. Its decoded section formula is e applied to e inverse of the explicit diagonal section, so follows from Equiv.apply_symm_apply.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0GLZ, diagonal unit and transpose argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0GLZ
proof_origin.note: Concrete diagonal unit, proved naturality, and categorical assembly; only unique extension remains open. The equivalent existential CoreHomEquiv split was rejected and removed.

theorem proEtaleComparisonSectionAdjunction (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)) ⥤
      Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1)))
    (e : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (Y : X.ProEt),
      (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y) ≃
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F).obj.obj
          (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))))
    (hres : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
      (Y Z : X.ProEt) (g : Z ⟶ Y) (s : (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y)),
      e F Z ((A.obj F).obj.map g.op s) =
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g.left) (Type (u + 1))
            (Y.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Z.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
              ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).hom.app
                (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))) ≫
            (etaleSetTerminalTransport Y.hom g.left Z.hom g.w F).inv) (e F Y s))
    (hfun : ∀ (F F' : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (ψ : F ⟶ F')
      (Y : X.ProEt) (s : (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y)),
      e F' Y ((A.map ψ).hom.app (op Y) s) =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).map ψ).hom.app
          (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))) (e F Y s))
    : ∃ adj : A ⊣ (Scheme.toProEt X).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type (u + 1)) X.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X),
    ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
      (U : X.Etale) (s : F.obj.obj (op U)),
      letI : (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ U.hom).IsContinuous
          (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
          (U.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) :=
        Scheme.isContinuous_overPullback @Etale @Etale le_rfl U.hom
      e F ((Scheme.toProEt X).obj U)
        ((adj.unit.app F).hom.app (op U) s) =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback U.hom).obj F).obj.map
          (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
            (pullback.lift (𝟙 U.left) (𝟙 U.left) (by simp)) (by simp) :
            Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 U.left) ⟶
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ U.hom).obj U).op
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ U.hom) (Type (u + 1))
            (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (U.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app F).hom.app (op U) s)
